observedElements: Directly viewed architect photos show red-brown brick lower floors, a pale upper finish, repeated white-framed windows, dark roof/eaves, metal balconies on a photographed corner, a full-height glazed atrium with dark mullions, a pale name panel and projecting canopy.
Architect project description identifies a three-storey atrium with floor-to-ceiling glazing and separate townhouse blocks behind the main building.
Original procedural brick and stucco tiles are generated for this asset; third-party photos are not shipped as textures.
estimatedElements: 10.1 m overall height and floor/material transition heights are estimates based on three-storey description and photo proportions.
The chosen 89.7 m footprint edge hosts a representative photographed facade; the photos have no compass bearing, so this placement is unverified.
Atrium width, window positions and dimensions, door dimensions, canopy size, sign lettering size, and all unseen wall/roof details are approximate.

Repeated framed windows on five additional long boundary edges are estimated side treatments inspired by the second directly viewed wing photo; edge assignment, bay spacing and dimensions are not compass-verified.
No detached rear townhouse blocks or unverified service-side details are invented.
